config.script:
# A double-clicked tag is chosen straight away; a folder just opens
	try: tagPath = (event.data or {})['tagPath']
	except: tagPath = None
	if not tagPath: return
	system.perspective.sendMessage("TagSelected", payload = {'tagPath': tagPath})
	system.perspective.closePopup('')

# A tag (not a folder) is the selection the Select button sends
	tagPath = None
	if event.selectionData:
		try: tagPath = event.selectionData[0]['tagPath']
		except: tagPath = None
	self.view.params.selectedTagPath = tagPath or ''

# Opening a folder for the first time reads its contents in place of the placeholder; only that level is read
	if not event.expanded: return
	data = event.data or {}
	try:
		folder, loaded = data['folder'], data['loaded']
	except:
		return
	if not folder or loaded: return
	root = self.view.rootContainer
	children = root.browseLevel(folder)
	items = root.plain(self.props.items)
	def find(nodes):
		for n in nodes or []:
			if n.get('id') == event.id: return n
			found = find(n.get('children'))
			if found is not None: return found
		return None
	node = find(items)
	if node is None: return
	node['children'] = children
	node['data']['loaded'] = True
	node['expanded'] = True
	self.props.items = items

# The providers, opened down to the starting tag (inputTagPath, e.g. the attribute's current tag) when there is one
	import re
	root = self.view.rootContainer
	# (re-run when custom.tagIndex arrives, so only folders with tags show)
	items = root.browseLevel('')
	m = re.match(r'^\[([^\]]+)\](.*)$', (value['path'] or '').strip())
	if not m: return items
	provider, rest = '[%s]' % m.group(1), [p for p in m.group(2).split('/') if p]
	level, path = items, provider
	for part in [None] + rest[:-1]:
		if part is not None: path = path + ('' if path.endswith(']') else '/') + part
		node = None
		for n in level:
			if n['id'].lower() == path.lower() and n['children'] is not None: node = n
		if node is None: break
		node['children'] = root.browseLevel(node['id'])
		node['data']['loaded'] = True
		node['expanded'] = True
		level = node['children']
	return items

# The starting tag selected (the tree drops an id it doesn't have)
	return [value.strip()] if value and value.strip() else []

transforms.code:
# Tags whose name contains the search text (as it's typed), across the providers the tree shows, first 200, shown as a tree
	# under their provider and folders, all open; nothing below 2 characters. UDT definitions (_types_) and our own assetOEE
	# instances' tags are left out
	text = (value['text'] or '').strip()
	hidden = list(value['hidden'] or [])
	if len(text) < 2: return []
	excluded = ['[system]', '[kanoames]', '[default]']
	paths = []
	for p in system.tag.browse('', {}).getResults() or []:
		provider = '[%s]' % str(p['name'])
		if provider.lower() in excluded: continue
		found = system.tag.browse(provider, {'name': '*%s*' % text, 'recursive': True, 'tagType': 'AtomicTag', 'maxResults': 1000}).getResults() or []
		for r in found:
			full = str(r['fullPath'])
			low = full.lower()
			if '_types_' in low.split(']', 1)[-1].split('/') or low.startswith('[kanoa]kanoa/') or [h for h in hidden if low.startswith(h)]: continue
			paths.append(full)
			if len(paths) >= 200: break
		if len(paths) >= 200: break
	# The tree: a provider, then each folder on the way to a tag, open
	top, nodes = [], {}
	for full in sorted(paths, key=lambda x: x.lower()):
		provider, rest = full.split(']', 1)
		provider += ']'
		parts = [s for s in rest.split('/') if s]
		level, path = top, provider
		for depth, part in enumerate([provider] + parts[:-1]):
			if depth > 0: path = path + ('' if path.endswith(']') else '/') + part
			node = nodes.get(path.lower())
			if node is None:
				node = {'id': path, 'label': part, 'expanded': True, 'children': [], 'data': {'folder': path, 'loaded': True}}
				nodes[path.lower()] = node
				level.append(node)
			level = node['children']
		level.append({'id': full, 'label': parts[-1] if parts else full, 'children': None, 'icon': {'path': 'material/local_offer'}, 'data': {'tagPath': full}})
	return top
return (value or None) is not None

customMethods.name: browseLevel
customMethods.script:
# One level of the tag tree: the folders (and UDT instances) under path, then its tags, each by name. A folder gets a
	# placeholder child, so it can be opened; opening it reads its contents (the tree's onToggle). path '' lists the providers.
	# Only the levels opened are ever read: the selector used to read every tag in every provider up front, which on a big
	# gateway took gigabytes of the gateway's memory once the tree was expanded (ClickUp 868mw4ex6)
	excluded = ['[system]', '[kanoames]', '[default]', '[kanoa]kanoa']	# lower case
	results = system.tag.browse(path, {'maxResults': 1000}).getResults() or []
	# The folders with a tag that can be picked below them (custom.tagIndex); others would open empty
	withTags = set([str(f) for f in (self.view.custom.tagIndex.folders or [])])
	folders, tags = [], []
	for r in results:
		name = str(r['name'])
		full = ('[%s]' % name) if path == '' else str(r['fullPath'])
		if name == '_types_' or full.lower() in excluded: continue
		# Our own assetOEE instances (each asset's Line) aren't for picking
		if str(r.get('typeId') or '').lower() == 'kanoa/assetoee': continue
		# Only atomic tags can be picked; folders and UDT instances open; anything else (an empty folder too, which the browse
		# reports with no children) is left out
		tagType = str(r['tagType'])
		if path == '' or tagType in ('Folder', 'UdtInstance', 'Provider'):
			if full.lower() not in withTags: continue
			folders.append({'id': full, 'label': name, 'expanded': False, 'data': {'folder': full, 'loaded': False},
				'children': [{'id': full + '/~loading', 'label': 'Loading...', 'disabled': True, 'children': None, 'data': {}}]})
		elif tagType == 'AtomicTag':
			tags.append({'id': full, 'label': name, 'children': None, 'icon': {'path': 'material/local_offer'}, 'data': {'tagPath': full}})
	key = lambda n: n['label'].lower()
	return sorted(folders, key=key) + sorted(tags, key=key)

customMethods.name: plain
customMethods.script:
# The tree's items as plain dicts and lists (the property tree's wrappers can't be edited in place this way)
	if o is None or isinstance(o, (basestring, bool, int, long, float)): return o
	if hasattr(o, 'keys'): return dict([(str(k), self.plain(o[k])) for k in o.keys()])
	try: return [self.plain(x) for x in o]
	except TypeError: return o
